projectName.description: Project name. If omitted, defaults to the current working directory's name (sanitized: non-alphanumeric characters replaced with '-').

spec.description: Path to the base spec.ive.yaml. Defaults to 'spec.ive.yaml' if omitted.

activeGenerations.description: Names of the generations (keys of 'generations') to run by default when no specific generation is passed via CLI.

generations.description: Map of generation name -> its configuration.

adapterSource.description: Path or URL to an adapter-sdk.json this dependency resolves to.

dependencies.description: Map of dependency name (referenced from the spec) -> where to load its adapter-sdk.json from (local path or URL).

outputDirectory.description: Project-wide default output root. Individual generations can override this.

vars.description: Custom variables, substituted like {projectName} in fileName/fileNamePattern/outputDirectory/relativePath/templateRoots. Cannot contain a key literally named 'projectName' (reserved).

platformCatalog.description: Path or URL to the platform catalog (Envelope requirements/errors/profiles), used to infer/validate errors from Envelope requirements. Same local-or-remote mechanism as dependencies.adapterSource.

expandOverlayRefs.description: If true, expands $refs added by overlays inline.

resolveSpecRefs.description: If false, does NOT expand $refs from the base spec.

extends.description: Path to a base generation config (YAML/JSON) to deep-merge with this one.

source.description: Overrides the input source for this generation (defaults to the project's base spec).

templateRoots.description: Template repositories to load, in cascade order (later roots override same-named helpers from earlier ones).

overlays.description: Overlay names/paths to apply, in order. A bare name (no extension) resolves to '<configDir>/overlays/<name>.ive.yaml'; a name with any extension is used as-is.

outputDirectory.description: Root output directory for this generation. Supports {projectName} and any declared 'vars' key.

fileName.description: Required in practice when scope is 'global' (or a sensible default of '<artifactType>.out' is used).

fileNamePattern.description: Required in practice for perIntent/perFlow/perView/perGroup scopes (uses {IntentName}/{FlowName}/{ViewName}/{GroupName} placeholders accordingly).

exclude.description: Names (Intent/Flow/View) to skip for this artifact, even if present in the adapter.
